organisations.name: CIRCA Volunteering Agency
organisations.description: Central volunteering agency for the Isle of Man. Matches volunteers with charities best suited to their skills and experience. First point of contact for anyone wanting to volunteer.

organisations.name: Council of Voluntary Organisations (CVO)
organisations.description: Umbrella body for charities and voluntary organisations on the Isle of Man. Provides advice, support, and shared resources for third sector organisations.

organisations.name: Manx Care — Noble's Hospital Volunteering
organisations.description: Volunteer at Noble's Hospital in various roles including: Conversation/Activity Companion, Maternity Unit Assistant, Garden Assistant, Macmillan Cancer Support, and Bridge the Gap Pod.
organisations.address: Noble's Hospital, Braddan, Isle of Man, IM4 4RJ

organisations.name: Manx Wildlife Trust
organisations.description: Relies on dedicated volunteers throughout the year. Opportunities include managing nature reserves, wildlife surveys, helping in shops in Peel and Douglas Sea Terminal, and joining the Board of Directors.

organisations.name: Beach Buddies IOM
organisations.description: Keeps Isle of Man beaches and coastal areas clean and beautiful. Organises regular beach cleaning events and makes it simple for anyone to get involved.

organisations.name: Samaritans Isle of Man
organisations.description: Volunteers provide confidential emotional support to people in distress or at risk of suicide. Available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Training is provided.

organisations.name: Victim Support Isle of Man
organisations.description: Registered charity providing emotional and practical support to victims of crime and witnesses at court through the Witness Service. Independent from the Police.

organisations.name: St John Ambulance Isle of Man
organisations.description: Provides first aid cover at public events and community settings. Trains volunteers in first aid skills and runs First Aid in Schools programme. Community First Responders also needed.

organisations.name: Salvation Army Isle of Man
organisations.description: Provides community support, Christmas toy appeals, prayer rooms, and social services. Volunteers help with outreach programmes, events like Christmas Live, and community activities.

organisations.name: Isle of Man Civil Defence Corps
organisations.description: Volunteer emergency response team trained in flood response, hill search and rescue, 4x4 driving, rest centre training, and using emergency lifesaving equipment.

organisations.name: RNLI Isle of Man
organisations.description: Royal National Lifeboat Institution stations at Douglas, Ramsey, Peel and Port Erin rely on volunteer crew to save lives at sea. Crew and shore crew opportunities available.

organisations.name: Scouts Isle of Man
organisations.description: Volunteer leaders and helpers needed for Scout groups across the island. Roles include section leaders, assistants, and activity helpers for young people aged 4-25.

organisations.name: Girlguiding Isle of Man
organisations.description: Volunteer leaders and helpers for Rainbows, Brownies, Guides and Rangers across the island. Help girls and young women develop skills, confidence and friendships.

organisations.name: Motiv8 IOM (Drug & Alcohol)
organisations.description: Support organisation for people affected by drug and alcohol issues. Volunteers help with befriending, activities, and supporting recovery programmes.

organisations.name: Manx SPCA
organisations.description: Volunteers help with animal care, adoption events, fostering animals, fundraising and charity shop work. Help rehome cats, dogs and small animals.

organisations.name: Isle of Man Mountain Rescue
organisations.description: Volunteer team providing search and rescue in upland and difficult terrain. Requires physical fitness and commitment to training. Essential for TT and Manx Grand Prix events.

organisations.name: Age Concern Isle of Man
organisations.description: Supports older people across the island. Volunteers help with befriending, transport to appointments, day centre activities, and reducing social isolation.

organisations.name: Macmillan Cancer Support IOM
organisations.description: Provides free, confidential non-clinical support to anyone affected by cancer. Volunteers support patients, carers, and family members through Noble's Hospital service.

organisations.name: IOM Foodbank
organisations.description: Volunteers help sort and distribute food donations, assist with collections, and support families in crisis. Essential community service especially during winter months.

organisations.name: Isle of Man Arts Council
organisations.description: Supports arts and cultural events across the island. Volunteer opportunities include stewarding at events, helping with festivals, and supporting local artists.

organisations.name: TT Marshals & Volunteers
organisations.description: Essential volunteers needed for the Isle of Man TT races and Manx Grand Prix. Roles include marshals, medical assistants, hospitality, parking, and event support.

organisations.name: Hospice Isle of Man
organisations.description: Volunteers support patients and families at the hospice. Roles include befriending, gardening, administration, fundraising, and charity shop work across the island.

organisations.name: Citizens Advice IOM
organisations.description: Trained volunteers provide free, confidential advice on debt, benefits, housing and legal issues. Training is provided and roles include advisers and administrative support.

organisations.name: IOM Domestic Abuse Helpline
organisations.description: Volunteers support survivors of domestic abuse through helpline work, advocacy, and community awareness. Training and supervision provided. Free and confidential 24/7 service.

organisations.name: Literacy & Numeracy IOM
organisations.description: Volunteer tutors help adults improve their reading, writing and maths skills. Training and materials provided. Flexible hours to suit the volunteer.

organisations.name: Manx Radio Community
organisations.description: Volunteer presenters, researchers and production assistants support community broadcasts. Good communication skills needed. Training provided for new volunteers.

organisations.name: Manx Heart Support Group
organisations.description: Supports people with heart conditions and their families. Volunteers help at group meetings, assist with hospital visits, and support fundraising activities.

organisations.name: Isle of Man Special Olympics
organisations.description: Volunteer coaches, helpers and event organisers support athletes with intellectual disabilities in a wide range of sports. No sports coaching experience necessary.

organisations.name: IOM Museum Volunteers
organisations.description: Volunteer guides and assistants at Manx National Heritage sites including the Manx Museum, Castle Rushen, Peel Castle and Cregneash Village. Share Manx history with visitors.
organisations.address: Various MNH sites, Isle of Man

organisations.name: Tynwald & Government Volunteers
organisations.description: Help at Tynwald Day and government-organised community events. Welcome visitors, assist with logistics, and represent the Isle of Man's unique democratic tradition.
organisations.address: St John's & Douglas, Isle of Man

organisations.name: Childline IOM Supporters
organisations.description: Support the Childline service which helps children and young people. Volunteer counsellors and fundraisers needed. Extensive training provided for counsellor roles.

organisations.name: Isle of Man Mencap
organisations.description: Supports people with learning disabilities and their families. Volunteer opportunities include befriending, social activities, sports support and fundraising.

organisations.name: Red Cross Isle of Man
organisations.description: British Red Cross volunteers support vulnerable people in crisis. Roles include emergency response, hospital transport, refugee support and community services.

organisations.name: IOM Community Sports Clubs
organisations.description: Hundreds of sports clubs across the island need volunteer coaches, administrators, and event helpers. Football, cricket, rugby, swimming, athletics and more.

organisations.name: IOM Befriending Network
organisations.description: Matches volunteers with isolated or lonely individuals for regular visits or phone calls. Makes a huge difference to vulnerable people living alone. Flexible commitment.
